solution: A well-trained Blastoise with strong Water-type moves like Hydro Pump or Aqua Tail can easily overpower Charizard due to its type advantage and high defensive stats.
A Rhyperior with Solid Rock ability and moves like Stone Edge or Rock Wrecker can crush Charizard, leveraging its 4x resistance to Fire and super-effective Rock-type attacks to dominate the battle.

A Slowbro with Psychic-type moves like Psychic or Psyshock, combined with its high Special Defense and access to Slack Off for recovery, can outlast and overpower Charizard by exploiting its vulnerability to Psychic attacks while mitigating damage from Fire-type moves.
